name: fivetran-activations
description: Fivetran Activations (formerly Census) reverse ETL and governed audiences — no Activations-native MCP server, so the sync path runs on the Activations REST API / Terraform provider

requirements: Fivetran account (Census was acquired by Fivetran and is now Fivetran Activations — Census is no longer a standalone product)
Activations REST API or Terraform provider credentials for the reverse-ETL sync path
Warehouse model and destination connection for the syncs (200+ destinations), plus Audience Hub for governed segments
notes: There is NO Activations-native MCP server: create and manage reverse-ETL syncs through the Activations REST API or the Terraform provider.

Fivetran hosts an 'Agent Context MCP server' exposing semantic definitions and READ-ONLY warehouse SQL, and publishes a self-hosted MCP repository in its own GitHub org for platform operations — neither is Activations-specific.
Activations offers a REST API, a Terraform provider, a Management API and Connect Links.
The 'url' field is null on purpose: no Activations MCP endpoint exists to point at.

upstreamTools: Fivetran Agent Context MCP — semantic definitions
Fivetran Agent Context MCP — read-only warehouse SQL
Activations REST API — audiences and syncs
